description: This file is a script for detecting changes in a project directory, specifically tailored for a CI/CD pipeline. It parses changed file paths, identifies relevant scopes (such as Node, MacOS, Android, Windows, etc.), and outputs boolean indicators for which environments or tests should be run based on the changes.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Determines which parts of the project are affected based on the list of changed file paths. Returns an object indicating which environments should be triggered.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Executes a Git command to list changed files between two commits or points, returning an array of file paths.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Appends the scope detection results to the specified GitHub output file, used for conditional job execution in workflows.
